blocked_sentences: {1}{U}, {T}, Exile seven cards from your graveyard: Add {U}. When you spend this mana to cast a spell or activate an ability, copy that spell or ability. You may choose new targets for the copy

needs.what: mana_spent_trigger must also fire when the tagged mana pays the cost of a non-mana activated ability, binding that ability on the stack as `subject` so the rider can `copy_ability` it (and `copy_spell` it with `new_targets` when it paid for a spell); the rider needs to branch on whether `subject` is a spell or an ability
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_spent_trigger is spell-only: the loader compiles it from a synthetic `spell_cast` trigger and costs.pay_mana queues it via _queue_spend_triggers only when record_colors_on is set, which only the spell-cast paths pass; an activated ability's mana payment never checks spend tags, so the 'or activate an ability' half would silently do nothing
